text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Why, yes. I'd like to buy some moxa, but
I can't
seem to find any...

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text: M-moxa? I don't think we stock that...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Is that right? Sigh... I just can't seem to shake this exhaustion...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I don't suppose you have bamboo
poles? You
know, those round pieces
you step on to massage
your feet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Wonder Acute is even more
fatigued
than I expected. It might be
good to rethink her
race schedule...
